title: The Toolkit
subtitle: Curated developer tooling, platform engineering utilities, continuous delivery consoles, and source infrastructure.

overview.summary: A centralized platform hub and developer toolkit catalog. Features standalone nodes for mission-critical engineering hubs including Argo CD GitOps controller at argo.devutkarsh.com and GitHub source control repository at github.com.
overview.problemStatement: Modern engineering teams require rapid discovery and direct access to essential developer tooling, deployment management consoles, and version control repositories without navigating fragmented bookmarks or nested wiki pages.
corePrinciples: Decoupled Tooling Architecture: Independent operational nodes mapped directly to active endpoints.
GitOps-Driven Platform Delivery: Argo continuously synchronizes declarative state from Git to production clusters.
Centralized Source Control: GitHub acts as the single source of truth for code, pipeline configurations, and security scanning.
Frictionless Developer Experience: Direct deep-links and operational telemetry accessible from a unified dashboard.

data.label: Argo
data.subtitle: argo.devutkarsh.com
data.description: Declarative GitOps continuous delivery controller and workflow engine running at argo.devutkarsh.com. Automatically syncs Kubernetes cluster state with version-controlled manifests and monitors application health.
responsibilities: Role-based access control (RBAC) and audit logging
failureModes: Webhook connection timeout to Git provider
Cluster API rate-limiting during mass syncs

configSnippet.code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: production-services
  namespace: argocd
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/utkarsh/infra-manifests.git
    targetRevision: HEAD
    path: k8s/production
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: prod
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true

data.label: GitHub
data.subtitle: github.com
data.description: Enterprise version control, CI/CD automation, pull request reviews, and security scanning platform hosted at github.com. Acts as the primary Git source of truth for application code and infrastructure manifests.
responsibilities: Immutable Git version history and branch protection
Automated CI testing via GitHub Actions runners
Pull request code reviews and automated merge queues
failureModes: GitHub API rate-limiting on token exhaustion
Runner queue backlog during peak commit windows

configSnippet.code:
name: CI/CD Pipeline
on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm test

tradeoffs.chosenApproach: Pull-based reconciliation via Argo CD controller
pros: Zero cluster credentials exposed to external CI runners
Continuous automated drift detection and self-healing
Declarative rollback to previous Git commits
cons: Small sync delay between Git commit and cluster apply
rejectedAlternatives: Push-based CI pipelines running kubectl directly with cluster admin tokens

tradeoffs.chosenApproach: GitHub Cloud with Branch Protection & Actions
pros: Industry-standard developer ergonomics and ecosystem integrations
Built-in secret scanning, Dependabot, and automated workflows
cons: Action runner concurrency limits on standard tiers
rejectedAlternatives: Self-hosted GitLab/Gitea instances with manual maintenance and backup overhead

securityAndCompliance.implementation: Enforce short-lived OIDC tokens and multi-factor authentication across GitHub and Argo CD UI.
All sensitive secrets encrypted using Sealed Secrets or external Vault integration before committing to repositories.
All pull request approvals, merge operations, and GitOps sync events recorded in immutable audit logs.
